content: Sɑɑ ye Dɑfidi u kɑ Sɔɔlu ɡɑri kuɑ u kpɑ, Yonɑtɑm u nùn kĩɑ nɡe win tiin hunde mɑ u kɑ nùn bɔrɔnu kuɑ ɡem ɡem.
Sɑɑ mɑɑ dɔmɑ ten diyɑ Sɔɔlu u nùn mwɑ u yi u ǹ mɑɑ wure u dɑ win tundon mi.
Yonɑtɑm u bɔ̃ruɑ mɑ u ko n sɑ̃ɑ Dɑfidin bɔrɔ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ yèn sɔ̃ u nùn kĩ nɡe win tiin hunde.
Yerɑ u win tiin yɑberu potɑ u Dɑfidi kɑ̃ kɑ mɑɑ win tɑbu yɑberu kɑ mɑm win tɑkobi kɑ win tɛndu kɑ win kpɑkɑ.
Mi Sɔɔlu u Dɑfidi tɑbu ɡɔrɑ kpuro, u rɑ nɑsɑrɑ suewɑ. Yen sɔ̃nɑ u nùn kuɑ win tɑbu kowobun tɔnwero. Mɑ n tɔmbu kpuro dore kɑ mɑm Sɔɔlun tɑbu durɔbun tii.
Sɔɔlu
u kɑ Dɑfidi nisinu seewɑ

Sɑɑ yè sɔɔ tɑbu kowobɑ wee tɑbu ɡberun di, mi Dɑfidi u Filisiti wi ɡo, yerɑ tɔn kurɔbɑ yɑrimɑ Isirelibɑn wusu kpuron di bu kɑ Sɔɔlu sennɑ. Bɑ yɑɑmɔ bɑ bɑrɑnu kɑ mɔrɔkunu soomɔ, bɑ kuuki mɔ̀ kɑ nuku dobu.
Bɑ womusu mɔ̀ bɑ mɔ̀,

content.text: Sɔɔlu u rɑ nɔrɔm nɔrɔm (1.000) ɡo.
Adɑmɑ Dɑfidi u rɑ nɔrɔbun subɑ wɔku wɔkubu (10.000) ɡo.

content: Gɑri yi, yi ǹ kɑ Sɔɔlu nɑɑwɛ, mɑ u mɔru bɑrɑ ɡem ɡem. U nɛɛ, bɑ Dɑfidi siɑrɑ nɔrɔbun subɑ wɔku wɔkubun sɔ̃, ɑdɑmɑ nɛɡibu nɔrɔm nɔrɔm tɔnɑ. Mbɑ nɑ mɑɑ kɑ Dɑfidi kere sinɑ ɡɔnɑ bɑɑsi.
Sɑɑ dɔmɑ ten diyɑ Sɔɔlu u kɑ Dɑfidi nɔnu kɔ̃su mɛɛrim toruɑ.
Yen sisiru Gusunɔ u derɑ hunde kɔ̃sɑ yɑ Sɔɔlu seeri mɑ u bindimɔ win yɛnun suunu sɔɔ u ɡɑri ɡerumɔ nɡe bũnuɡii. Mɑ Dɑfidi u mɔrɔku suɑ u nùn soowɑmmɛ nɡe mɛ win dɔɔnɛ. N deemɑ Sɔɔlu u win yɑɑsɑ nɛni.
Mɑ u ye fĩɑ u kɑ Dɑfidi sɔku u nɛɛ, kon kɑ nùn ɡɑnɑ mɛnnɑwɑ. Nɡe mɛyɑ u kuɑ sere nɔn yiru, ɑdɑmɑ Dɑfidi u ye kpuro fukɑ mɑ Sɔɔlu u nùn kɔmiɑ.
Yen biru Sɔɔlu u Dɑfidi nɑsiɑ, domi u ɡiɑ mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn deri, mɑ u kɑ Dɑfidi wɑ̃ɑ.
Yerɑ n derɑ u nùn dɛsirɑsiɑ win bɔkun di u nùn kuɑ tɑbu kowobu nɔrɔbun (1.000) tɔnwero. Mɑ Dɑfidi u Isirelibɑ kpɑrɑ tɑbu sɔɔ.
Ye u ɡɔ̃ru doke u ko kpuro, yɑ rɑ koorewɑ, domi Yinni Gusunɔ u wɑ̃ɑ kɑ wi.
Ye Sɔɔlu u wɑ ye Dɑfidi u mɔ̀ kpuro yɑ rɑ koorewɑ, yerɑ u nùn nɑsiɑm sosi.
Adɑmɑ Isirelibɑ kɑ Yudɑbɑ kpuro bɑ Dɑfidi kĩɑ yèn sɔ̃ u bu kpɑrɑmɔ ben tɑbu sɔɔ.
Dɑfidi u Sɔɔlun bii Mikɑli
suɑ kurɔ

Mɑ Sɔɔlu u Dɑfidi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn bii wɔndiɑ ɡbiikoo Mɛrɑbuwɑ kon nun kɛ̃ kurɔ. Adɑmɑ ɑ de ɑ n sɑ̃ɑ dɑmɡii kpɑ ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ sɑnnɑ. Domi Sɔɔlu u bwisikɑ u nɛɛ, u ǹ kĩ u nùn ɡo win tii, Filisitibɑrɑ u koo nùn bɔrie.
Adɑmɑ Dɑfidi u Sɔɔlu wisɑ u nɛɛ, yinni, wɑrɑ rɑ n nɛ. Mbɑ nɛn yɛnuɡibu kɑ nɛn tundon bweseru n kɑ sere ko wunɛn dokiri.
Adɑmɑ sɑɑ ye Sɔɔlu u koo Dɑfidi Mɛrɑbu wi wɛ̃ kurɔ, sɑɑ yerɑ u nùn suɑ u Adiriɛli, Mɛholɑɡii wɛ̃ u suɑ kurɔ.
N deemɑ Sɔɔlun bii wɔndiɑ ɡoo, wi bɑ mɔ̀ Mikɑli, u Dɑfidi kĩ. Ye bɑ Sɔɔlu ɡɑri yi sɔ̃ɔwɑ, n nùn dore.
Mɑ u nɛɛ, kon nùn wi kɛ̃, kpɑ u ko yinɑ Filisitibɑ bu kɑ Dɑfidi nɔmɑ turi. Mɑ u Dɑfidi sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɔn yiruse u nɛɛ, sɑɑ ɡisɔn di kɑɑ ko nɛn dokiri.
Mɑ Sɔɔlu u win bwɑ̃ɑbu yiire bu kɑ Dɑfidi ɡɑri yi ko nɛkɛ nɛkɛ bu nɛɛ, wee, sunɔn nukurɑ do wunɛn sɔ̃. Win bwɑ̃ɑbu kpuro bɑ mɑɑ nun kĩ. Yen sɔ̃, ɑ de ɑ n sɑ̃ɑ win dokiri.
Mɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ Dɑfidi ɡɑri yi nɔɔsiɑ. Mɑ Dɑfidi u nɛɛ, bɛɛn nɔni sɔɔ ɡɑ̃ɑ piiminɑ mi? Bu nɛɛ, nɑ sɑ̃ɑ sunɔn dokiri? Nɛ bwɛ̃ɛbwɛ̃ɛwɑ wi bɑ kun ɡɑrisi ɡɑ̃ɑnu.
Mɑ Sɔɔlun ɡɔro be, bɑ wurɑ bɑ nùn Dɑfidin ɡɑri yi sɔ̃ɔwɑ.

Sɔɔlu u nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ i ko i Dɑfidi sɔ̃ i nɛɛ, nɑ ǹ dokirirun ɡɑ̃ɑnu ɡɑnu kĩ, mɑ n kun mɔ Filisitibɑn sen sɑrusu wunɔbu (100). Yerɑ yɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑ mɔru kɔsiɑru nɛn yibɛrɛbɑn mi. Sɔɔlu u yeni ɡerumɔwɑ kpɑ Filisitibɑ bu kɑ Dɑfidi ɡo.
Ye bɑ dɑ bɑ Dɑfidi ɡɑri yi sɔ̃ɔwɑ yɑ nùn dore u n kɑ sɑ̃ɑ sunɔn dokiri. Tɔ̃ɔ te bɑ koo nùn kurɔ wɛ̃ tu sere turi,
u seewɑ kɑ win tɑbu kowobu bɑ dɑ bɑ Filisitibɑ ɡo tɔnu ɡoobu (200). Mɑ Dɑfidi u kɑ ben sen sɑrusu nɑ u su ɡɑrɑ tiɑ tiɑ u sunɔ wɛ̃. Sɑɑ yerɑ Sɔɔlu u nùn win bii Mikɑli wɛ̃ kurɔ.
Ye Sɔɔlu u ɡiɑ mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ Dɑfidi wɑ̃ɑ, win bii Mikɑli u mɑɑ nùn kĩ ɡem ɡem,
yerɑ u nùn nɑsiɑm sosi. Mɑ u kuɑ win yibɛrɛ win wɑ̃ɑru kpuro sɔɔ.
Yen biru Filisitibɑn tɑbu sinɑmbu bɑ rɑ n wɔrɑɑ nɑɑmɔ Isirelibɑn mi. Dɑfidi ù n kɑ bu sɑnnɑ, u rɑ nɑsɑrɑ suewɑ n kere Sɔɔlun tɑbu tɔnwero be bɑ tie. Yen sɔ̃nɑ u yĩsiru yɑrɑ.
